instrument: アコースティックギター（レギュラーチューニング、カポなし）
notes_ja: 【1〜11小節（イントロ）】原曲のイントロはバイオリンだけで、ギターは入っていません。このTABはバイオリンのラインをギターに移したものなので、難しければ休んで12小節から入ってもかまいません。弾く場合は指弾きで、全部7ポジション（7〜10フレット）です。1〜6小節は3弦7（D）と4弦7（A）を交互に鳴らし続け、3小節1拍目と5小節3拍目だけ1弦10（高いD）を重ねます。2・4・6小節の後半は C–B–A（4弦10・9・7）を2回。7〜10小節は C（1弦8）–B（1弦7）–A（2弦10）のメロディーに、2・3・4拍目の頭で3弦7のDを重ねます。11小節は3弦7＋1弦10を伸ばし、その間に12小節の D5 へ左手を移します。【12小節目から】録音のコード・コードが変わる位置・キメに合わせたアコギ用アレンジです。1拍（付点4分）を「ダウン（4分）＋アップ（8分）」で刻むジグのストローク（譜面の ⊓＝ダウン、V＝アップ）。13・15・17・19・21小節と28〜32小節の後半は、ベースとドラムに合わせて4分音符でダウンを3回（キメ）。使うフォーム（6弦→1弦）：D5 = xx023x、Csus2 = xx001x、Am7 = x0001x、D = xx0232、G = 320033、Bm = xx4432、Asus4 = x00230、Esus4 = 022200。
method: Bars 1-11: VERDICT: no separate guitar in bars 1-11; the high-register line the user hears is the violin (two-voice playing on open D + its stereo reverb). Evidence weighed: 4 independent lenses (envelope/pluck calibration, stereo/pan-coherence masks, video bow tracking, doubling/beating) all found no plucked attack, no off-grid or off-centre onset stream, no 3rd/6th/octave partner line; all high-register attacks coincide with the violinist's bow reversals. Judge re-checks: (1) video frames 1.0-3.15 s show a flat bow with raised arm (G/D strings) vs steep bow at 11.6-13.1 s (A string); (2) E5 (3rd harmonic of A3) rises 10-15 dB in the "A" eighths of bars 1-6, so the A there is A3 on the G string (its 2nd harmonic A4 is the loudest partial), likewise the C4/B3 figure of bars 2/4/6 (h1 -3..-11 dB re h2; absent under the A-string motif of bars 7-10); (3) the C5 that lingers under B4 in bars 7-10 has L/R coherence 0.21-0.64 vs 0.80-0.97 for the active B4 and 0.98-1.00 at C5 attacks = diffuse reverb, not a coherent second source; (4) only anomaly: odd partials of the bars 2/4/6 figure lean right (G5 pan -0.23..-0.38) while C4/C5/B4 are centred - no plucked onset or separate timing accompanies it, so it is read as mic/directivity, not a guitar. TRANSCRIPTION: per-eighth CQT tables (36 bins/oct, mid), partial envelopes, dominant-pitch tracking and onset/bow tables; sounding pitches kept (A3/B3/C4/D4 in bars 1-6, C5/B4/A4/D5 over D4 in 7-11); jig rhythm D(2)-A(1)|A(3) per half bar is a simplification of bowed eighth re-articulations; tiny violin ornaments (C/B grace notes at pos 5/11, slides into A in bars 4/6, faint pos-2 re-bows in bars 7-10) omitted. Fingering: everything in 7th position (frets 7-10). VALIDATION (pluck synth vs other.wav high-passed 200 Hz): onset F (80 ms) all bars 0.81 (P 0.85, R 0.76), 50 ms 0.75; chroma per bar mean 0.94 (plain D4 drone baseline 0.74), half-bar mean 0.92. Per bar: 1: onF 0.73 / chroma 0.94; 2: onF 0.75 / chroma 0.90; 3: onF 0.71 / chroma 0.92; 4: onF 0.84 / chroma 0.88; 5: onF 0.92 / chroma 0.90; 6: onF 0.71 / chroma 0.91; 7: onF 0.88 / chroma 0.98; 8: onF 0.88 / chroma 0.97; 9: onF 0.80 / chroma 0.98; 10: onF 0.89 / chroma 0.96; 11: onF 0.57 / chroma 0.97. Octave check (semitone CQT A3-C#6 correlation): bars 1,3,5,6 fit better at the written octave, bars 2/4 slightly better 8va (0.40/0.42 vs 0.33/0.39) because the violin's G-string notes radiate mostly their 2nd harmonic - hence the 8va option in notes_ja. Chords/change points from the reconciled harmony; groove = 12/8 jig strum (down quarter + up eighth per dotted-quarter beat) matching the drum pattern; hemiola half bars (three quarter-note hits) wherever the bass plays them; intro arpeggio mirrors the audible D-A-D eighth figure; voicings follow the pad's chord tones in open position.
intro_verification: Independent verification (2026-11-05), scripts and images in work/intro_gtr/verify/ (v1-v20, cqt_final_*.png, env_*.png, voices_*.png, zoom_*.png, pitchcheck_final.txt, metrics_*.json). VERDICT CHECK: agrees that no separate guitar is audible in bars 1-11. Own evidence: (a) all intro energy is in other.wav (bass/drums/vocals stems and the mix-minus-stems residual are about 40-60 dB down until the bar-11 pickup); (b) stopped notes carry violin vibrato (bar-7 C5 track range 78 cents) while open-string notes are dead steady (A4 in bars 7/9/10/11 +4..+9 cents, sd 2-4 cents; D4/D5 in bar 11 track each other at +11..+14 cents) - a fretted doubling would show as a steady line under the vibrato and none was seen; (c) the bars 1-6 A has its 3rd/5th harmonics (E5, C#6) and sits 16-19 cents flat with vibrato in bars 2/3/5, i.e. a stopped A3 on the G string, and the bars 2/4/6 C carries G5 (its 3rd harmonic, -23..-30 dB) that is absent (-45..-61 dB) under the A-string C5 of bars 7-10, so C4/B3 is the right octave; (d) the side (L-R) copy of the violin band lags the mid by about 64 ms in bars 1-10 - a stereo delay/reverb that can sound like a second instrument shadowing the violin; (e) own video frames (frames_grid.png: 0.9/2.85/5.95/8.95 s vs 9.7/10.45/13.0/16.5 s) show only the violinist, with a flat bow and raised arm (G/D strings) during the bars 1-6 drone and the C-B-A figures, and a steep bow (A string) from bar 7 beat 1 on. EVENT CHECK (36-bin/oct CQT with the part overlaid for every bar, 46 ms STFT partial tables, harmonic-specific voice curves, basic-pitch onsets as a third opinion): all tab frets equal the written pitch in standard tuning; no C/C# or B/Bb errors (neighbour semitones 10-25 dB lower; the few low-row flags are weak G-string fundamentals, settled by h2/h3); schema ok (pos+dur<=12, ties end on the barline into a matching pitch). CHANGES (75 -> 75 events): 1) bars 2/4/6: removed the C4 at pos 5 - the C enters on pos 6 in all three bars (C5/G5 rise at pos 5.6-6.0, basic-pitch C4 onsets at 6.0/5.7/5.9; pos 5 is still A, the old pos-5 C came from the long low-frequency CQT window smearing C4 backwards); A3 at pos 3 now lasts 3 eighths. 2) bars 2/4/6: B3 at pos 7 shortened to 1 eighth and an A3 added at pos 8 - A4/C#6 rise at pos 7.7-8.5 in all three bars and basic-pitch finds A3 at 8.0/7.5/7.9, so the figure is C-B-A | C-B-A. 3) bars 2 and 6 pos 11: C4 -> A3 (A4, E5 and C#6 rise from pos 10.4-10.8, basic-pitch A3 at 10.6/10.2; bar 4 already had A3). In bar 6 a fresh C5 without the C4 3rd harmonic also sounds at pos 10.9-11.4 (possible double stop or pickup), left out. 4) bar 7 pos 0: A3 -> A4 (s2f10): no A3 3rd harmonic (E5 -41..-44 dB), and the A is pitch-steady like the open A string (+9 cents, sd 3.7), unlike the vibrato G-string A3 of bars 1-6, and the bow is already at the A-string angle at 9.7 s. 5) bar 8: B4+D4 at pos 6 (dur 3) -> D4 at pos 6 + B4 at pos 7 (dur 2): the B4 dips at pos 6.2-7.0 and re-swells at pos 7.1 (basic-pitch B4 onset 7.1), the same shape as bars 7/9/10. 6) bar 9: removed the C5 at pos 5, B4 from pos 4 now lasts 2 eighths (B4 5-15 dB above C5 through pos 4-5.3; basic-pitch B4 3.7-7.0). Bar 7 keeps B4-C5 at pos 4/5 because there C5 >= B4 at pos 4.6-5.0. 7) bar 3 pos 0 and bar 5 pos 6: D4 -> D5+D4 (D5 is 10-17 dB above D4 there, against -1..-7 dB at the other D attacks; the same criterion as the existing D5 in bar 10). NOT CHANGED but noted: the D4/A3 rocking of bars 1-6 is really a bowed double stop that re-articulates almost every eighth (broadband onsets at pos ~5 of most bars are D4 pulses); the D(2)-A(1)|A(3) rhythm is a playable simplification. In bar 8 the tied C5 decays by about pos 1.5 (written dur 3 = let ring). In bar 11 the D5 may partly be the open D4 2nd harmonic. Ornaments (16th C-B turns in bars 7-10, B->C slide into pos 6 in bars 4/6) are omitted. VALIDATION before -> after: onset F80 0.805 -> 0.818, onF50 0.755 -> 0.767, chroma/bar 0.937 -> 0.934, half-bar 0.920 -> 0.926, per-eighth semitone-spectrum fit 0.545 -> 0.542 (better at the corrected slots: bar 2 pos 5 -0.19 -> +0.37, pos 11 +0.24 -> +0.37, bar 4 pos 5 +0.01 -> +0.29; lower at bar 8 pos 6-8 only because the schema forbids overlapping notes, so the D4 at pos 6 is written for one eighth while the real drone keeps ringing). Confidence: bars 1-7 and 11 medium (ornamented bowed double stops; bar 6 pos 11 and bar 7 pos 0 are the least certain), bars 8-10 high.
